subject: Observability technical sprint RFP & joint pilot proposal
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@datadog.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi@grafana.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability technical sprint RFP & joint pilot proposal

Hi Ellen + Ravi,

Following up from last week's alliance call — Redwood's product & partner teams scoped a short RFP to propose a joint technical sprint: goal is to validate OTLP ingestion compatibility, verify prefix/KV cache behavior across our serving runtime, and define indicators we'll measure during a 4-week field pilot.

High-level ask: can Datadog + Grafana commit a combined technical contact and a proposed 2-week window in July for a 1-day kickoff + 3 technical workshops? We're proposing the following sprint objectives:
- ingest OTLP traces/metrics from Redwood edge agent into Datadog (sample workloads)
- validate Grafana dashboard templates and alerting for model-inference latency/cold-starts
- establish mutual action plan for pilot metrics and SLIs (latency p95, token cost delta, error-rate)

I've attached the draft RFP and a mutual action plan template for your review (RFP_SprintScope_v1.pdf, MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v3.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
1) You review scope and flag any non-starters by Thu 10 Jun
2) We schedule a kickoff (1 hour) for week of 12 Jul
3) Ben/Neha will lead the commercial/field enablement side; Marissa will help with integration QA.

Would appreciate if you could confirm the right technical owners on your side and any calendar constraints.

Thanks,

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RFP_SprintScope_v1.pdf (5 pages, PDF), MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v3.xlsx (workbook)
From: Ellen Park <ellen@datadog.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi@grafana.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Observability technical sprint RFP & joint pilot proposal

Laura — thanks for the concise scope. This looks sensible and we're interested.

Quick notes / questions from the Datadog side:
- I'll be the commercial lead; I'm looping in our integrations lead, Samir Patel (samir.p@datadog.com), who will own the technical schedule and a pre-sprint checklist.
- For ingestion tests, do you have sample payload sizes and qps expectations? If you can include a short traffic matrix (tokens/sec, request sizes), that will help us size an internal cluster for the pilot.
- Grafana dashboards: are you expecting us to maintain dashboard exports or provide panels for embedding in Grafana Cloud?

We can commit to a 1-hour kickoff between 12–16 Jul — I can do 13 Jul in the morning (PDT). Samir will coordinate a 2-hour workshop afterwards to validate traces -> spans mapping.

I'll review the MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN and provide edits by EOD Thu. Attaching our intake checklist (inline link) and adding it to the shared Confluence.

Best,
Ellen

--
Ellen Park
Partner Sales, Datadog
ellen@datadog.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Subject: Re: Observability technical sprint RFP & joint pilot proposal

Ellen / Ravi — appreciate the quick response.

Answering the traffic question: we've attached a short traffic matrix to the mutual action plan tab in MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v3.xlsx, but TL;DR for a representative pilot workload:
- inference requests: 250 reqs/sec peak (varies by model family)
- average payload: 1.2 KB per request (OTLP spans ~600B each)
- p95 target latency to observe: 120ms (end-to-end)

Goals we care about for the pilot (we'll measure these jointly):
- Latency p95 for small/medium sequences
- Token cost delta vs baseline (no caching)
- KV cache hit-rate during steady-state test

I've also drafted a mutual action plan in the spreadsheet with owners and tentative dates — see the attached. From a commercial standpoint, Redwood can supply a small sponsored capacity pool for initial tests (details in the spreadsheet).

Proposed kickoff: 13 Jul 10:00 PDT (we'll hold 1 hour). Proposed workshops: 14 Jul deep-dive (2 hours), 19 Jul follow-up (1 hour). Please confirm availability and whether Samir should be the day-to-day technical PM.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0124

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v3.xlsx (updated — traffic matrix tab)

Ben / Laura — thanks for the detail and for including Grafana. We're on board with the proposed objectives. A few items from our side:
- We can provide dashboard exports (JSON) and a telemetry panel pack for the pilot; we'll also add a test folder to Grafana Cloud so you can validate embeds.
- For the workshops, Samir (Datadog) + our integrations engineer, Priya Verma (priya@grafana.com), should join the deep-dive.
- We request a short acceptance criteria appendix in the mutual action plan that includes: successful dashboard rendering, thresholded alert test cases, and a list of synthetic traces used for verification.

13 Jul 10:00 PDT works for our team — confirming calendar invite momentarily. We'll aim to have the dashboard pack and a first-draft acceptance appendix by 11 Jul EOD.

Looking forward — Ravi
